title: Stylized materials and deterministic procedural rock stamp

material.materialWeights: Authoritative per-vertex rock/dirt weight; Color.r stores dirt weight
material.projection: UV0 baked from each triangle's dominant-normal axis and MatterMeshVertex.SourcePositionMeters
material.transformStability: Projected rest-space coordinates are invariant under object translation and rotation
material.textureProvenance: First-party deterministic 128x128 textures generated from fixed local seeds; no external or paid inputs

remediation.dirtClassification: Material-only band at y < 0.28m within existing solid samples; no outward skirt geometry
remediation.geometryOccupancyContract: Resolved MatterWorld solid occupancy equals the generator field; material classification does not expand silhouette
remediation.materialContract: Low-frequency surface treatment, cool slate-gray rock, warm brown dirt, reduced normal intensity
remediation.remainingVisualRisk: Seed 19 remains a weak broad form; image quality awaits independent root review

generator.sourceAuthority: Recipe primitives are generation input only; resolved samples are ordinary rock/dirt MatterWorld authority.

playerObservation.maximumInterpretation: Single startup capture; not a performance observation

independentRootReview.visualFinding: The remediation improves silhouette diversity, hierarchy, recesses, face readability, and removes the broad dirt skirt, but the gallery still reads predominantly as qualification graybox/SDF clasts rather than deliberately authored stylized game assets. Rock material character and macro variation remain too weak in the hero images, and several seeds retain the same fused-clast language.
independentRootReview.technicalFinding: Authority, deterministic generation, embedded material classification, one-surface seam, rest-space projection, tests, and Windows build proof pass their bounded technical checks.
independentRootReview.phaseDecision: Do not admit U5. Stop the overnight run at U4 under the repeated visual-gap rule. No Unreal work was started.

limits: Do not infer mixed-resolution stitching; U3 local refinement remains unsolved.
